content: Service Name Bmc_FetchSub_u Syntax Bmc_AtomicUType Bmc_FetchSub_u ( volatile Bmc_AtomicUType * Object, Bmc_AtomicUType Operand ) Service ID [hex] 0x60 to 0x63 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Operand Value for the operation Parameters (inout) Object Object Parameters (out) None Return value Bmc_AtomicUType The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects Description Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the result of the subtraction applied to the value pointed to by Object and the given Operand. Available via Bmc.h
